definitions.gloss: custom-made clothing, made-to-order clothing, bespoke clothing
definitions.explanation: Clothing that is made to an individual customer's measurements and specifications, as opposed to ready-made or off-the-rack clothing.

examples.japanese: {注文服|ちゅうもんふく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ぴったり→ぴったり：02362_pittari⟧⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧。
examples.english: Custom-made clothing fits the body perfectly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結婚式|けっこんしき}→結婚式：05493_kekkonshiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{注文服|ちゅうもんふく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦スーツ→スーツ：01367_suutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I had a custom suit made for the wedding.

examples.japanese: {注文服|ちゅうもんふく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{既製服|きせいふく}→既製服：19980_kiseifuku⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{着心地|きごこち}→着心地：07269_kigokochi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{全然|ぜんぜん}→全然：00598_zenzen⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧。
examples.english: Custom-made clothing is more expensive than ready-made, but the comfort is completely different.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}→注文：03485_chuumon⟧ (order, custom order) + ⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧ (clothing). Also called オーダー⟦メイド→メイド：12377_meido⟧ (order-made) in Japanese, which is a wasei-eigo term.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {注文服|ちゅうもんふく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to have custom clothing made
- {注文服|ちゅうもんふく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕立|した}て→仕立て：11645_shitate⟧: tailoring of custom clothing
- {注文服|ちゅうもんふく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧: custom clothing shop

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{既製服|きせいふく}→既製服：19980_kiseifuku⟧: ready-made clothing, off-the-rack — the opposite; mass-produced in standard sizes
- オーダー⟦メイド→メイド：12377_meido⟧: custom-made — wasei-eigo loanword, more commonly used in casual conversation
- ⟦{仕立|した}て→仕立てる：09525_shitateru⟧⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧: tailored clothing — emphasizes the tailoring process
